```json
 "rationale": "At vin = 0.75 V the NMOS (VGS 0.75) and PMOS (VSG 1.05) both sit in moderate inversion. The gains add, giving GBW of about 1.5 mS / (2*pi*0.55 pF), roughly 400 MHz at about 45 uA (about 80 uW). Short L sets the gain from gds to about 12-15, so the -3 dB point lands above 25 MHz. Rf (much larger than 1/gds) stabilises vout_dc near 0.75-0.9 V while drawing little current at the extremes. Both devices have a low vdsat (<0.15 V), which keeps the swing near 1.5 V."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "Wn":     (4.0,   1.0,   20.0),    # NMOS driver width [um]
    "Ln":     (0.18,  0.15,  0.5),     # NMOS length [um]
    "Lp":     (0.18,  0.15,  0.5),     # PMOS length [um]
    "p_trim": (1.0,   0.7,   1.4),     # PMOS width trim vs. current-matched width (sets vout_dc)
    "Rf":     (60e3,  10e3,  300e3),   # DC-centring resistor vout->vin [ohm]
    "Wb":     (1.0,   0.5,   4.0),     # ibias sink diode width [um]
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref_assumed = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)

    Wn, Ln, Lp, Rf = p["Wn"], p["Ln"], p["Lp"], p["Rf"]
    vgs_n = vin
    vsg_p = VDD - vin

    # Size the PMOS so its current matches the NMOS at vout = 0.9 V (mid-rail target)
    v_t = 0.9
    In_t = lut.op("n", Wn, Ln, vgs_n, v_t)["Id"]
    Ip_unit = lut.op("p", 1.0, Lp, vsg_p, VDD - v_t)["Id"]
    Wp = max(0.42, min(4000.0, Wn * In_t / max(Ip_unit, 1e-12) * p["p_trim"]))

    # Solve for the DC output via KCL at vout: Ip = In + (vout - vin)/Rf
    def kcl(v):
        In = lut.op("n", Wn, Ln, vgs_n, v)["Id"]
        Ip = lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, vsg_p, VDD - v)["Id"]
        return Ip - In - (v - vin) / Rf

    lo, hi = 0.05, VDD - 0.05
    for _ in range(40):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if kcl(mid) > 0:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    vout = 0.5 * (lo + hi)

    on = lut.op("n", Wn, Ln, vgs_n, vout)
    op_ = lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, vsg_p, VDD - vout)
    G = 1.0 / Rf
    gm = on["gm"] + op_["gm"]
    gds = on["gds"] + op_["gds"]
    gain = (gm - G) / (gds + G)
    cpar = 0.35 * (on["cgg"] + op_["cgg"])          # drain-side (Cgd + Cdb) estimate
    ctot = cl + cpar
    f3db = (gds + G) / (2 * PI * ctot)
    gbw = gain * f3db
    idd = op_["Id"]
    power = VDD * (idd + iref_assumed)
    swing = VDD - max(on["vdsat"], 0.1) - max(op_["vdsat"], 0.1)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("MN1", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ln)
    n.M("MP1", "vout", "vin", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.R("RF", "vout", "vin", Rf)
    # The reference current only needs a DC path: sink it in a small diode-connected NMOS
    n.M("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wb"], 1.0)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": 20 * math.log10(max(gain, 1e-6)),
        "f3db": f3db,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vout,
        "swing": swing,
    }
```
